source.positions: World AABB center of each named body mesh after its complete node hierarchy and GPU instance transform. Original model origins are retained per marker.
source.chestCoverage: All five identifiable luggage body meshes in every enabled canonical map. These meshes are also used by mirages and traps; scene placements are reference candidates, never a guarantee of a real chest or its contents.
source.itemCoverage: Authenticated named fixed resource or climbing landmark meshes: egg nests, shelf fungi, hammered pitons, climbing spikes, sleep-berry sites and four amulet reference sites. Amulet models are candidate sites, not guaranteed pickups. Nap Berry is also used by a fixed sleep-effect FakeItem. Spawned loose items and random item-spawner contents are absent from static map geometry.
source.animalCoverage: Individual fixed Capybara bodies identified by the exact Cube mesh and M_Capybara material in every canonical map. M_Capybara Mirage bodies are excluded. These are original map placements, not live animal state.
source.excluded: Unqualified generic mesh names, capybara mirages, chest lids and hardware, decorative props, unverified pickup locations, and data from another game build.
source.componentCoverage: Authenticated pickup-spawner, plant, vine, ground-forage and campfire reference points from the selected canonical scene layers and the active MapHandler.globalParent subtree. Ordinary anchors use controller world positions; ScoutStatue reward anchors use the serialized gemSpot Transform. Global points retain global scope without inferred chapter ownership. Contents, quantity, chance, ascent, player requirements and the all-amulets reward condition remain game-controlled. Markers describe source spawn references rather than live item state.
